title: Supplier Discovery / Gran Canaria
objective: Locate and evaluate suppliers capable of operating products for THE FIX (Destination Management) in Gran Canaria: (A) private chauffeur transport with Mercedes-Benz Vito / V-Class or clearly equivalent premium vehicles, and (B) official/accredited Gran Canaria tourist guides. Produce a reasoned, sourced shortlist of about five defensible candidates per category to support a human decision. This builds a reusable Gran Canaria supplier network; it is not limited to one product.

categories.label: Chauffeur / Mercedes Vito – V-Class
categories.description: Private chauffeur-driven transport providers operating in Gran Canaria with Mercedes-Benz Vito / V-Class or clearly equivalent premium vehicles, suitable for small premium groups of international clients.
criteria: Mercedes Vito or V-Class, or clearly equivalent premium vehicle
Able to operate routes across the island

categories.label: Official guides – Gran Canaria
categories.description: Official / accredited tourist guides working in Gran Canaria, with excellent English and knowledge of gastronomy, culture, heritage, territory, ethnography and nature (hiking where applicable); experience with private clients, small groups, MICE or premium tourism is valuable.
criteria: Official tourism guide or relevant accreditation
Experience with private clients, small groups, MICE or premium tourism

fields.label: Gastronomy / culture / heritage / territory / ethnography / nature

constraints: Do not invent B2B conditions, prices, fleet information, languages, accreditations or capabilities: unsupported information is UNVERIFIED.
Statuses are CANDIDATE or SHORTLIST only; no supplier is approved by ATLAS.
Individual guides are natural persons: use only professional, publicly listed information.
Quality over quantity: a reasoned shortlist, not a directory dump.
context: Immediate use case: a THE FIX small-group premium experience in development — Queso de Guía territory experience, Monte Pavón walking component, La Colonial. Do not bias the whole search toward this one product.
